claims: The 2026 Sidemen Charity Match took place on Saturday, April 18, 2026.
The 2026 Sidemen Charity Match was held at Wembley Stadium, London.
The official kick-off of the 2026 Sidemen Charity Match was at 3:00 PM BST.
The official kick-off of the 2026 Sidemen Charity Match was at 10:00 AM ET.
The live stream of the 2026 Sidemen Charity Match began at 2:10 PM BST.
The 2026 Sidemen Charity Match was won by the YouTube All-Stars following a penalty shootout.
The 2026 Sidemen Charity Match raised over £6.2 million for charity.
